value.markup:
crombolo init

Scaffold a site in the current directory. Each run acts again.

crombolo init [--force] [--name <name>] [--postgres] [--template <template>]
ArgumentWhat it is
--forceOverwrite files that are already here.
--nameThe site's name.
--postgresConfigure Postgres rather than SQLite.
--templateA starter template, or `list`.

crombolo start

Boot the site in the current directory. Each run acts again.

crombolo start [--keep-admin] [--bundle <bundle>] [--from <from>] [--postgres] [--name <name>] [--no-install] [--allow-missing-media] [--label <label>] [--backup-taken] [--under <under>] [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--allow-missing-blobs] [--publish] [--no-schema] [--no-files] [--replace-files]
ArgumentWhat it is
--keep-adminDon't touch the administrator's password.
--bundleApply a bundle's content first; repeatable.
--fromIn an empty folder: a site from a whole-site file.
--postgresWith --from: configure Postgres.
--nameWith --from: the site's name.
--no-installWith --from: skip `bun install`.
--allow-missing-mediaWith --from: import media items whose files the file does not carry.
--labelA label for a bundle's import run.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.
--underPlace the bundle under this page.
--resolveAnswer a finding: <key>=take-bundle|keep-local|skip, or <key>/<property>[@<culture>]=take-bundle|keep-local.
--resolve-allAnswer every finding the same way. One of take-bundle, keep-local, skip.
--allow-missing-blobsImport media items whose files the bundle does not carry.
--publishPublish what it imports.
--no-schemaDecline the schema the bundle carries.
--no-filesDecline the views, styles and scripts it carries.
--replace-filesAllow replacing files this site has; the originals are kept for a revert.

crombolo status

What this environment is, and what is wrong with it, without starting it. Changes nothing.

crombolo status

crombolo health

Run the site's health checks. Changes nothing.

crombolo health [--group <group>]
ArgumentWhat it is
--groupOnly this group of checks.

crombolo generate

TypeScript for the content types in schema/. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo generate

crombolo export

Write the whole site to one file, to move it to another machine or host. Each run acts again.

crombolo export --site [--out <out>] [--no-media] [--drafts] [--with-members] [--with-users] [--anonymise] [--name <name>] [--package-version <package-version>]
ArgumentWhat it is
--siteThe whole site (required: a part of it is `content export`). Required.
--outThe file to write.
--no-mediaLeave the media files out.
--draftsDrafts too.
--with-membersMembers, encrypted.
--with-usersBack-office users, encrypted.
--anonymiseReplace every personal value as it writes.
--nameThe package's npm name.
--package-versionThe package's version.

crombolo schema

This CLI described for machines, as a clispec v0.3 document. Changes nothing.

crombolo schema

crombolo schema add-property

Append a property to a type, and apply it. Each run acts again.

crombolo schema add-property <type> <alias> --type <type> [--name <name>] [--description <description>] [--mandatory] [--tab <tab>] [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
typeThe type's alias. Required.
aliasThe property's alias. Required.
--typeThe data type. Required.
--nameThe property's name.
--descriptionThe property's description.
--mandatoryAn editor must fill it in.
--tabThe tab it goes in.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo schema check

Validate schema/ and report what a sync would do to this database. Changes nothing.

crombolo schema check [--static]
ArgumentWhat it is
--staticValidate the files only, no database.

crombolo schema export

Write the database's definitions as schema/ files. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo schema export

crombolo schema new

Write a type file, with keys, and the view it points at, then apply it. Each run acts again.

crombolo schema new <kind> <alias> [--name <name>] [--description <description>] [--icon <icon>] [--at-root] [--element] [--tab <tab>] [--no-view]
ArgumentWhat it is
kindWhat kind of type. One of content-type, media-type, member-type. Required.
aliasThe type's alias. Required.
--nameThe type's name.
--descriptionThe type's description.
--iconThe type's icon.
--at-rootAllow it at the root of the tree.
--elementAn element type, for blocks.
--tabThe tab its first property goes in.
--no-viewNo view: a type nothing renders.

crombolo schema purge

Delete properties retired more than N days ago, with their values. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo schema purge --older-than <older-than> [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
--older-thanHow long, in days, a property must have been retired. Required.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.

crombolo schema rewrite

Rewrite every schema/ file canonically. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo schema rewrite

crombolo schema sync

Apply schema/ to the database. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo schema sync [--force-retire-types]
ArgumentWhat it is
--force-retire-typesRetire a type the files no longer have even though content uses it.
